title: Avoid composite orderable type uppercase allocation
description: Replace composite index orderable-column data type to_ascii_uppercase matching with direct ASCII case-insensitive comparisons.

criteria: Composite index orderable type matching no longer allocates uppercase data type strings
Integer, boolean, date, timestamp, datetime, and interval type recognition remains ASCII case-insensitive
Timestamp/datetime parameterized forms and interval subtypes remain recognized by prefix
Non-orderable text-like and near-miss type names remain rejected

notes: The helper uses byte-prefix comparison to avoid allocating uppercase strings.
composite_column_type_is_orderable now checks exact type names and known prefixes with ASCII case-insensitive comparisons.
Composite index key encoding, range bound construction, and SQL-visible output are unchanged.
